title: fix(plugin-charts): data labels print in their value axis's units and the tallest mark keeps its label on the chart
body:
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YKe7vvuJjvvPs61VEnCbHs)_ Fixes #27372 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:图表数据标签改用其所在数值轴自己的刻度格式化器(无作者格式时与轴同为紧凑单位,如 `174K`),并在开启数据标签时给竖向图表加顶部留白,最高柱的标签不再画到图外。 - 为什么改:HotCRM 18.2.0 浏览器走查第 2–3 行:标签印 `174000` 而轴印 `400K`;最高柱的值标签整段被裁掉。表格末列与全零图两行实测后不改,理由见下。 - 风险与回滚:只动 `@object-ui/plugin-charts` 的 `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`;关闭数据标签的图表与横向柱图布局字节不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` 的 `DATA_LABEL_CHART_MARGIN` 与 `dataLabel` / `valueTickFormatterOf`;再看新测试 `AdvancedChartImpl.dataLabels-27372.test.tsx`。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.dataLabels-27372.test.tsx`,预期 11 passed。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` only: - **Row 2: data labels read in their axis's units.** `dataLabel` now takes the tick formatter of the value axis the series is drawn against: `yTickFormatter` on a single-axis chart, `leftYTickFormatter` / `rightYTickFormatter` by the series' `yAxis` on a dual-axis chart (`valueTickFormatterOf`), and by the series' axis id on a combo. Each of those is already `formatterFor(axis.format) ?? formatYTick`, so an authored `yAxis[].format` still wins and an axis without one gives its labels the compact default. Before, the label called `formatterFor(axis.format)` with no fallback and printed the raw number. Dashboard charts are the common case: `chartConfig` carries no axis format at all. - **Row 3, tallest bar: label headroom.** With `showDataLabels` on, a vertical bar, line, area or combo chart takes `DATA_LABEL_CHART_MARGIN`: a top margin of recharts' 5px plus the label's offset (5px) and font (11px). A margin rather than a domain pad, so an authored `yAxis.max` keeps pinning the domain. Charts without data labels and horizontal bars keep recharts' default margin. The label's font size and offset are now named constants (`DATA_LABEL_FONT_PX`, `DATA_LABEL_OFFSET_PX`); their values are unchanged. - The unused `axisOfSeries` helper is replaced by `valueTickFormatterOf`. **Serial constraint with #27361:** this diff does not touch `DatasetWidget.tsx` or `utils.ts` and does not regenerate the sdui manifest, so it does not wait on #27361. ## Why Rows 2–4 of #27355 (HotCRM's 18.2.0 browser pass), carded as #27372. Each row was measured in real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) on a fixture dashboard rendered by the real `DashboardRenderer`, with dataset-bound bar, line, table and all-zero widgets and an object-provider table, at 1280px (tables also at 768px and 390px). HotCRM's metadata was not used. | Row | Reading before (`c4c515ad`) | Reading after | Outcome | |---|---|---|---| | 2 | Label `174000` beside y ticks `0 / 100K / … / 400K` | Label `174K`, ticks unchanged | done | | 3a | Tallest label `400000` box top at −11px from the svg top: outside the svg | `400K` box top at +5px: inside the svg | done | | 3b | Dataset table: scroller `overflow-x: auto`, `scrollWidth` 910 vs `clientWidth` 566, inside the card. Object-provider table: 971 vs 564, inside the card | (no change) | will not do: not reproduced | | 4 | All-zero bar and line: y ticks `0 1 2 3 4`, 5 grid/axis lines, the line drawn on 0 | (no change) | will not do | ## Acceptance notes - **Row 3b, not reproduced.** Neither dashboard table widget clips its last column out of reach. The dataset `table` (DatasetWidget's flat table) and the `provider: 'object'` table (ObjectDataTable → `data-table`) each keep their own `overflow-auto` scroller inside the card, and the last column scrolls into view at 1280, 768 and 390px. What reads as a clip is the scroll edge with no visible scrollbar: headless Chromium hides scrollbars by default, macOS shows them only while scrolling, and `data-table` shows its scrollbar on hover only. A visible overflow cue (an edge fade, say) would be polish, not a reachability defect, so no table widget is changed. If HotCRM's screen shows a column that cannot be scrolled to, the reading needed is the widget type and the scroller's `scrollWidth` / `clientWidth` there. - **Row 4, will not do.** The recorded decision in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (the "all-zero BAR drew 5,128 ink pixels of axes and ticks" paragraph) stands: zero is a value, the measured chart draws a usable zero baseline and ticks, and a "no data" state over real zeros would be false. - **Field format does not reach labels or ticks.** A measure's field `currency` / `percent` format reaches neither the axis ticks nor the labels on a dashboard chart (both read only `yAxis[].format`, which `chartConfig` does not carry). Not widened here: the labels now match the axis, which is the card's ask. - A horizontal bar's labels sit in the band beside each bar and were not measured as clipped; they get no new margin. ## Verification Head `27cff9de`.
New pin: AdvancedChartImpl.dataLabels-27372.test.tsx (11 cases) - Compact default beside a compact axis, for bar, line and area (`['174K', '400K', '251K', '92.5K']`, the axis itself asserted to read `400K`). - An authored `$0,0` format wins (`$174,000` …). - Dual-axis bar and combo: each series prints in its own axis's units (`174K …` left, `12.0 …` right with a right-axis `0.0` format). - The tallest label's baseline minus the label font is ≥ 0 for bar, line, area and combo; the plot top stays at 5px with labels off. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.dataLabels-27372.test.tsx` → 11 passed.
Ablations (each fix reverted through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored blob = HEAD) - Formatter dropped from the `LabelList` (raw labels): 10 of 11 red (`expected [ '174000', … ] to deeply equal [ '174K', … ]`); only the labels-off margin case stays green. - Top margin set back to 5px: exactly the 4 headroom cases red (`"400K" is drawn above the chart surface: expected -11 to be greater than or equal to 0`), the 7 others green.
Package and gates - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` → exit 0; Test Files 100 passed (100), Tests 1292 passed | 9 skipped (1301), on 27cff9de. - `eslint` on both touched files: 0 errors; warning count equal to `c4c515ad` (41). - `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` → 0 new citations. - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 35 derived, 35 run on 27cff9de; 34 exit 0 first pass. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exit 1 on one 15 s timeout in `check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts` (tree-sweep population test, a load timeout on a shared box; this diff touches no `ui/scripts` input); that file re-run alone under the lock: 83/83 passed, exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 35 accounted, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
